confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are bounded estimates from Taiwan-wide and Taichung/Taipei price references, adjusted upward for a resort town. Kenting-specific drink prices were not found, so beer, cocktail and wine are weak. Cocktail and wine were set from the local price relationship to beer (about 1.5 times beer), not from direct menu prices. Beer rests on one small-town data point. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and do not reflect any live booking pages or current listings. FX: the only RBA observation I could confirm was the RBA exchange-rates overview page, dated 2026-03-20. It is not verified as the latest observation for 2026-11-19. Later figures seen in search results came from third-party sites, so I did not use them.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kenting is a Taiwan resort town in Pingtung County. Food anchors use Taiwan-wide and Taichung/Taipei price levels (Numbeo-style meal references, café price ranges), adjusted upward for resort pricing. Accommodation is set from general knowledge of Kenting guesthouse and resort pricing in peak summer, not from inspected listings. Drink anchors use the Taiwan café and bar price relationship to beer.
